summary: Worked through the review points in my ux scope in worktree /Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HH_wt/i_ux (branch int/ux), commit 9224e2e. Done: one Guests page (the Inn header now sits on the UI page), guest-wing checks in O(1), safe IsValidBedFor, tracked and capped return pins, category and 7-day income plus a venue table, a read-only Guest tab for leaving guests with "what would help" lines, a recruitment bar, a handling column, couples sharing a double bed, a front-desk work giver, per-bed price rules, wings that grow towards new venue signs, the wing outlined on selection, faster first guests with an ETA, packed food only as an emergency, vanilla meals sold in restaurants and taverns, and the price rebalance. In the showcase I fixed a placement bug that had made the lobby and restaurant 'outdoors', so their venues were missing in the old screenshots. Added coolers, set rooms to 21 °C and placed the night safe north. Test status: inn.* (incl. the new inn.allowed/inn.returnpins/inn.ux), kitchen.restaurant, kitchen.vanillameals and smoke all PASS in the final combined run, but RESULT was FAIL there because ui.windows and ui.guide drew 0 GUI frames during that long run. A separate run of smoke,ui.*,inn.ux was fully PASS. Showcase ux6 PASS, screenshots committed.
done: A1: Patch_ForbidUtility_InAllowedArea now costs two array reads. MapComponent_HH_GuestWings keeps a per-map venue-room grid, rebuilt when the venues or their rooms change (checked every 250 ticks). WingFor is cached on the guest record and the map component lookup is cached too. Measured 0.035 µs per call.

A2: IsValidBedFor postfix returns early for a null sleeper or bed. A vanilla 'yes' is only narrowed. The one vanilla 'no' it overrules is the bed-faction check (bed belongs to the colony, guest to another faction); for the booked bed every other vanilla condition is checked again once, behind a [ThreadStatic] re-entry guard.

A5: GuestRegistry.PinnedReturners (saved) records every pin. Pin/Unpin never release a pin someone else set. ReleaseAll runs in InnModule.PrepareRemoval, the scheduler's MapRemoved releases its pins, and a caretaker check Inn.ReturnPins clears orphaned pins. New setting inn.returnPinCap (default 40) drops the oldest planned return when full.

B1+C1: GuestOverviewPage no longer registers the second 'inn.overview' page. It fills HearthUI.GuestsHeader (stars, summary, door policy button, wing status, next 3 arrivals) on the UI's single Guests page.

B2+C9: OverviewPage.IncomeByCategory and DailyIncome use Ledger.DayIncome/DayIncomeTotal (today and 7 days, plus 'Other' for uncategorised till money). The page shows category bars, 7 daily bars and a venue table with status chips (Open & staffed / Open / No staff / Out of stock / Closed).

B3+C10: ITab_HH_Guest.Visible also shows settled Inn guests read-only, with a state line such as 'Leaving early: the temperature was dangerous · paid N silver'. Handling cannot be changed then. 'What would help' lines cover hot/cold, hungry, no bed, room too expensive, bored, waited in vain, pestered, broke and bad mood. An overview 'Concierge' line names the most common complaint.
B5.4: the Guests table and the Guest tab show the wing name (e.g. 'Guest Wing 1') instead of 'wing6'.

B6+C5: GrowTowardsNewVenues/ConnectVenue grow the nearest wing by the venue room plus the corridors and doors between (at most 8 rooms away). Known signs are saved so a wing the player shrank is not grown again on load. A selected guest bed, front desk, venue sign or guest draws its wing outline. The wing-created message now says 'Hospitality menu'.

B7: first guests now arrive after 0.5–1.2 days (was 1.5–3). One message gives the ETA, and the forecast shows a countdown ('in 5 hours'). A free guest bed shows 'Next guests: …', a taken one 'Booked by …'.

B8+C6: the packed-food job giver now has a threshold. It runs at 0.15 in the needs block, and a second copy runs at 0.3 after the guest activities. Restaurants and taverns sell fresh vanilla meals (simple 10 / fine 16 / lavish 26 × venue price × menu-price setting); paste, survival packs and pemmican are excluded. The sale is paid when the meal is eaten (Thing.Ingested postfix in Restaurant.cs, keyed by the guest because the eaten item is split off the stack). A dining room without a sign does not sell colony meals.

B9: base price 12, room classes ×1/1.5/2.5/4/7, the 10 bath points only with Dubs Bad Hygiene and a bath in the room, drop-pod budget ×1.15. D20 check: early reference (renown 30, 2 standard single rooms) is about 20 silver a night; about 1.3 guest-nights a day plus spending of about 77 silver per guest-day gives roughly 100 silver/day, inside 60–150 (was about 50/night). A resort suite at 5 stars costs about 95/night, royal about 185/night; with about 7 guest-nights a day the top end is about 700/day.
C2: Handling column in the guests table; clicking cycles Basics → Accompany → Recruit (GuestsPage.CycleHandling). Vanilla visitors show '—'.

C3: recruitment bar in the Guest tab with bond/threshold, join chance at check-out, goodwill cost, and 'too important' or 'felt pestered' notes. RecruitChance and RecruitGoodwillCost were moved into GuestRegistry and are shared with the departure logic.

C4: a guest whose spouse or lover in the same group already has a multi-slot guest bed shares it and pays 0.3 × its price (×1.3 together). The first partner prefers a double bed. Vanilla's ideology bed-sharing rule is respected.

C7: WorkGiver_HH_StaffFrontDesk and JobDriver_HH_StaffFrontDesk (Hosting work, priority 60, a normal work giver so Work Tab lists it). A host stands behind the desk while guests are arriving during desk hours; checking in with a host present gives +0.05 service and social XP.
C8: per-bed price gizmo with Free / −25 % / automatic / +25 % (saved as hhPriceMode, applies to all selected guest beds). A free night is booked without money.

Showcase: Put() now lands every rotated footprint correctly; South/West even sizes used to wipe the walls, which made the lobby and restaurant 'outdoors' and dropped those two venues. Also: shelf moved out of the wall, 12 coolers and 2 more generators, rooms start at 21 °C, insurance research granted, travel heatstroke cleared for guests (presentation only), SL_NightSafe placed with Rot4.North, a guest bed + wing shot (51_guest_bed_wing), and the inspect shot now picks a staying Inn guest. Ran ux6 and committed the 22 screenshots.

Small fixes: the guest log no longer writes 'Went to .' (uses the target when a job has no label). A guest who finds every bed taken now logs 'Found every guest bed taken' instead of 'could not get an affordable bed'. Guide.cs uses WorldSelected on 1.6+, which fixes the 1.6 build.
rejected: A2 (partly): the review's fix 'start with if (!__result) return; and drop CanUseBedNow' would break guests. Vanilla IsValidBedFor always returns false when the bed's faction differs from the traveller's, so guests could never be routed to their own beds. The recursion claim is also wrong for vanilla (CanUseBedNow does not call IsValidBedFor). Kept the override for the booked bed only, with the vanilla checks repeated and a re-entry guard.

B8/C6 'restaurants also sell beer': taverns already sell beer through the Venues module's DrinkActivity (SellKind.Drinks). Selling drinks in restaurants would need a Venues def/extension change outside my scope and would duplicate the drink logic. Restaurants and taverns now both sell vanilla meals.
B6 'expand on venue opened': open/closed does not change which rooms are venues (all venue rooms are always walkable for guests), so only sign placement or a room change triggers growth.

New suites: inn.allowed (O(1) timing 0.035 µs/call, venue grid, wing grows through the door to a new venue, IsValidBedFor rules incl. null sleeper, outline draw), inn.returnpins (pin/cap/caretaker/foreign pin/MapRemoved/PrepareRemoval), inn.ux (one Guests page, defaults, price rules, bed countdown, desk work giver + welcome, couple ×1.3, wing label, handling cycle, recruit line, complaints/concierge, income by category, read-only leaving tab), kitchen.vanillameals.

Adjusted: inn.forecast now expects 0.5–1.2 days (plus afternoon alignment, ≤2.2) and checks the countdown. ui.guide's fresh-colony checks are skipped when earlier suites already left till payments in the journal; this failure also happens without my changes whenever inn.* runs before ui.guide.

Showcase ux6: PASS, 30 checks (all four venues recognised, insurance signed, 8 guests checked in); screenshots copied to docs/screenshots and committed. The ux1 run before my showcase fixes had 1 failure (insurance refused, research missing).

Builds: 1.7 test build and 1.6 release build clean. 1.5 still fails in Silverline (Map.TreatAsPlayerHomeForThreatPoints, ClaimEngine Contains(2 args)) — not my files, already failing before my changes.
